node.statement: Amplified projections: because an extended epsilon-C*-algebra makes every M_n tensor A an epsilon-C*-algebra with the compatible matrix multiplication, involution, unit, and diagonal amplification norm, P_n=I_n tensor P satisfies P_n^dagger=P_n and ||P_n^2-P_n||=||I_n tensor(P^2-P)||=||P^2-P||<=delta; likewise Q_n is a delta-projection, uniformly in n.
